import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_data = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#DC143C', '#32CD32'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fare distribution across passenger classes
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
fare_by_class = [df[df['pclass'] == i]['fare'].dropna() for i in [1, 2, 3]]
bp = ax3.boxplot(fare_by_class, labels=['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'],
                  patch_artist=True, widths=0.6)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], ['#FFD700', '#C0C0C0', '#CD7F32']):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 300)

# 4. Survival count by embarkation port
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embarked', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax4, 
                     color=['#DC143C', '#32CD32'], width=0.6)
ax4.set_title('Survival by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
port_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
ax4.set_xticklabels([port_labels.get(x.get_text(), x.get_text()) 
                     for x in ax4.get_xticklabels()], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
